about: The Coconuts row's previews while Clawd is home: Drink one has the boat fetch Clawd off the island, take him by the boardwalk to drink a coconut by the crate, toss the shell into the sea and bring him home again; Resupply then calls the seaplane, Clawd fetched to wait by the crate, the plane throwing down coconuts one at a time for Clawd to set in the crate, and Clawd taken home once it is done
